cardText: Build powerful web applications with Google's framework
descriptionText: Angular is Google's framework for building web applications with TypeScript. Learn modern Angular the way it is written today: standalone components, signals, the built-in control flow, zoneless change detection, signal forms and server-side rendering. The course also covers the older patterns you will still meet in real codebases, from NgModules and decorator inputs to reactive forms and RxJS, so you can read and migrate existing projects with confidence.
